comparison.objective: Wring a diagnostic swab in a squeezed extraction tube; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Record requires sustained bimanual squeeze, repeated shaft rotation and extraction while maintaining compression. Candidate requires hex-key use, collar tuning, relocking and physical cycle actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Record counts five turns under specified squeeze and continued squeeze during removal. Candidate measures carriage energy, velocity, travel and setting retention; rebound/overload/drift thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: The record tests coordinated compression and specimen extraction, not mechanical calibration.
